# SafeStan Safety Note

Compatibility: minor.

Protected data: `y`.

Generated files: `model_safe.stan`, `data_safe.json`.

Changes: reordered the model block so that each parameter receives its built-in prior before being used in any later sampling statement. The protected observation `y` remains a top-level data variable and is observed exactly once with `y ~ normal(...)`. No data fields were added or changed.
